plus_ps_button_compat.name: plus_inv_cache_clear
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Clear Inventory Cache
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Deletes this account's saved copy of your inventory at your next login, so the whole inventory is loaded from the server again (the login takes longer). Try it when folders look empty or items are missing. Nothing in your inventory is deleted.
